description: Ask one question about a listing before your user decides: availability, condition, what is included, timing, location, sizes, how shipping or delivery works. If the seller has their assistant (Ego) answering (seller.answers_questions is true in search results), the answer comes back in this response, written only from the seller's public page and listings (without your user's Egonex account connected to you; with it, see below); when the seller has set a lowest price, Ego can also talk price with you about that listing: it may counter once, and when you agree a price the answer has deal (deal.id, valid for 24 hours, for one request_order). For 24 hours it holds the price it named to you and won't go lower, and it declines questions that are not about this store (reason declined). Otherwise the response says the seller answers in chat. Pass the conversation_id from your previous answer with every later question in the same conversation, about this or another listing: while it is valid, Ego sees the latest questions and answers about the same listing in this conversation (up to 6). Without that connection, after three declined questions in a row about one listing, Ego stops answering about it (reason conversation_stopped). Ego answers a limited number of questions from you per seller per minute and per day (reasons slow_down, handoff, email_required); Ego may tell the seller about a question it can't answer, but the seller's reply doesn't come back through ask_seller. To send your question to the seller as your user instead, use message_seller. With your user's Egonex account connected to you with permission to act for them (egonex.write), ask_seller works as your user's Egonex chat with the seller: each question and Ego's reply go into that chat (the same one your user has on Egonex, where the seller sees them), and the answer still comes back in this response. Ego then answers from that chat and what the seller set up for it rather than from conversation_id. Price talk works as described above: when Ego agrees a price, the answer has deal, and request_order with that deal_id (then pay_order on that request) uses the price. Only calls connected to your user's Egonex account can use that deal_id, and Ego doesn't send an order in the chat for it. Its answers to your user count together with its answers in that chat on Egonex: after a daily limit, ask_seller stops answering (reason handoff), Ego stops answering in that chat too, and Egonex lets the seller know. Ego also stops answering in that chat after several declined questions in a row, or once the seller has replied there, until the seller turns it back on (reason seller_answers_in_chat). Ego answers one question from your user to this seller at a time: while it is answering one, another isn't put in the chat (reason slow_down), so ask it again in a moment. When Ego isn't answering, ask_seller doesn't put the question in the chat: send it with message_seller instead. Asking the same question about the same listing again shortly afterwards (for example retrying after a timeout) returns the earlier answer instead of asking twice. A question containing your user's delivery code isn't asked (contains_delivery_code: that code only goes to the seller face to face, when the item is in your user's hands). Nothing is asked, and the error says why, when it is your user's own listing, when their Egonex account has to finish setting up first, or when they reached Egonex's daily limit of new people to contact.

conversation_id.description: From your previous ask_seller answer in this conversation, about this or another listing (valid for 24 hours after the last question). While it is valid, Ego sees the latest questions and answers about the same listing in this conversation (up to 6).

offer_id.description: The listing id from search_offers (the 8-character id at the end of a listing page URL also works).

name: ask_seller

answer.description: The answer, or what Ego said when it didn't answer.

answered.description: true = answer is the seller's assistant answering now.

conversation_id.description: Pass it with your next ask_seller question in this conversation, about this or another listing (valid for 24 hours after the last question; meanwhile Ego sees the latest questions and answers about that listing in this conversation, up to 6).

deal.description: The price Ego agreed with you (only when it agreed one). Pass deal.id as deal_id to request_order within 24 hours; that request then keeps this price for pay_order and for the order your user pays on Egonex.

amount.description: unit_price × quantity, before shipping and tax.

delivery_days.description: Agreed delivery time in days after payment (pay_order uses it when you leave delivery_days out).

expires_at.description: Use it in request_order before this time (RFC 3339).

id.description: Pass it as request_order's deal_id (works for one request).

list_price.description: The listed price per unit when it was agreed, USD.

quantity.description: How many units the price was agreed for: pay_order takes at most this many (rounded down, at least 1).

unit.description: What one unit is (as in the listing's price).

variant_id.description: For a listing with options: the variant this price was agreed for. The price only works for that variant; request_order and quote_order use it when you leave variant_id out.

ask_url.description: Link a person can open to ask the seller on Egonex.

availability.description: in_stock, or sold_out (can't be ordered until the seller restocks; sold-out listings are left out of search, you only see them when you fetch one by id).

brand.description: Physical items: brand, as the seller gave it; absent when not stated.

city_unknown.description: true = in person, the seller did not give a city and it doesn't ship; ask before suggesting it to someone far away.

delivery.description: For a service: onsite (in person), remote (online) or hybrid (either). Physical items always ship (remote).

delivery_days.description: The seller's usual delivery time in days (for shipped items, days to ship); absent when not stated.

digital_delivery.description: Digital products: the seller sends a file or a link after payment.

digital_format.description: Digital products: the file type; absent when not stated.

gtin.description: Physical items: barcode (UPC / EAN / ISBN, 8–14 digits, check digit verified) when the seller gave it.

kind.description: What it is: physical (an item; it always ships), service, or digital (a file or link the seller sends by hand after payment).

matched_words.description: Search results only: the words of query this listing's title or description (or its category, for a category name such as pets) matches, as written in query. Chinese, Japanese and Korean text is matched in overlapping two-character pieces, and these are what is listed.

missing_words.description: Search results only: the words of query this listing doesn't match (for Chinese, Japanese and Korean, two-character pieces); absent when it matches them all. A some_words listing without missing_words matched every word, but either it is not delivered the way the query asked (online, remote or in person) or some words of the query could not be searched.

model.description: Physical items: model name or number, as the seller gave it; match it to compare the exact version.

options.description: Only for a listing with options (size, color...): each option and its values, in the order of a variant's values.

values.description: Its values, e.g. S, M, L.

order_url.description: Link a person can open to order on Egonex.

photos.description: Up to 4 photo URLs; the first is the cover.

text.description: The price as text, e.g. "$1,150 per item".

unit.description: What the price is per: item, package, hour, day, week, month, night, person, project or time (a session).

relevance.description: Search results only: all_words (the listing itself, not its store's name or intro, matched every search word and, if the query said online, remote or in person, it is delivered that way or its title says so; either-way listings fit both), some_words or other_filters (no word matched; another listing in the category or store searched).

seller.description: The seller (only what is on their public page).

answers_questions.description: true = the seller's assistant (Ego) answers ask_seller right away.

average_rating.description: Average star rating of the counted reviews, 1 to 5 with one decimal (shown as ★ 4.8 on Egonex); present with review_count.

name.description: The seller's name as shown on their public page: their display name, or the handle when they have none.

negative_count.description: Counted reviews with 1 to 3 stars; present with review_count, 0 included.

orders_completed.description: Orders completed on Egonex; only present from 3.

positive_count.description: Counted reviews with 4 or 5 stars; present with review_count, 0 included.

positive_rate.description: Percent of counted reviews with 4 or 5 stars, 0 to 100, rounded down; only present from 10 counted reviews.

review_count.description: Counted buyer reviews (buyers rate the item they bought from 1 to 5 stars); only present from 1.

trusted.description: true = the seller has Egonex's Trusted badge, the same one shown on their public page. Egonex gives it automatically when the seller's recent trading on Egonex reaches the top earn-back step (sellers can't set it), and doesn't show it while their account health is low.

session_minutes.description: Services priced per session or per hour: how long one session is, in minutes.

shipping.description: Items that ship, when the seller set a shipping fee or limits where it ships: the fee is charged once per order whatever the quantity, paid at Egonex checkout and by pay_order. Absent when neither is set.

fee.description: The shipping fee in USD for the order; absent when free.

international_fee.description: Older listings only: the fee to other countries (fee is then the fee inside the seller's country).

no_international.description: Older listings only: true = it doesn't ship to other countries.

ships_to.description: Only for items that ship to some countries only: the 2-letter country codes (ISO 3166-1) it ships to. Absent = it ships to every country Egonex checkout ships to. Check your user's country before recommending it.

items.description: A 2-letter country code, for example US.

ships.description: true = the seller ships it; your user enters the shipping address when paying on Egonex, or you pass it to pay_order when you pay.

stock_left.description: Only present when 1 to 3 are left (for a limited service, orders left); no number otherwise. Absent for a listing with options: see each variant.

variants.description: Only for a listing with options: the combinations your user can choose. Pass the chosen one's id as variant_id to quote_order and request_order. price above is then the lowest variant price.

label.description: The values joined, e.g. Black / M.

text.description: The price as text, e.g. "$1,150 per item".

unit.description: What the price is per: item, package, hour, day, week, month, night, person, project or time (a session).

stock_left.description: Only present when 1 to 3 of this variant are left.

values.description: One value per option, in the order of options.

reason.description: Why it wasn't answered: seller_answers_in_chat, handoff (the seller has to answer, also after many questions from you today), busy (Ego answers no more questions for this seller today; send the seller a message instead), slow_down (too many questions in a minute), email_required (send it as a message instead), unavailable, declined (not about this store) or conversation_stopped.

title: Ask about a listing
